evidence.ref: A new metrics-area module .warp/entropy.py derives a per-area cost-to-change SERIES from what the loop ALREADY records. The per-correlation components (tokens, cost_usd, human_minutes, review cycles from verdict.recorded, gate failures from correlated gate.failed) are read through metrics.compute's new cost_by_correlation aggregation (a second VIEW of the same events keyed by correlation_id, extracted into metrics.cost_by_correlation and called from compute so the map, the dashboard, and the budget enforcer read the ONE aggregation - no new instrumentation, no second store). area_series attributes each SHIPPED change (a correlation with a spec.shipped event) to the contract area(s) its spec's placement/footprint touched via arch.footprint_areas (the W3 join key); a cross-area change contributes its recorded cost to EACH area it touched, and a change with no placement (pre-W3 history) is UNATTRIBUTED and counted, never dropped (the best-effort limit the plan's data-provenance section names). python3 .warp/entropy.py renders the per-area report over the real recorded stream.

scripts/selftest.py WARP-1108 AC1: over seeded events with an injected area index, alpha's human_minutes series is time-ordered [10,10,10,10,10,10,10,30] and tokens [100..100,300]; review_cycles are counted from verdict.recorded; the attributed/unattributed counts are {attributed:14, unattributed:1} (the orphan change is counted, not dropped); metrics.compute exposes cost_by_correlation with the recorded components (human_minutes, tokens, review_cycles, gate_failures, shipped_at); and a cross-area change contributes its cost to each of the two areas it touched.

detect_crossings implements the D2 threshold policy: per area and per recorded dimension it compares the LATEST sample against the mean of the trailing baseline_window PRIOR samples and flags a crossing when the latest is at least baseline * (1 + degradation_factor) with a positive baseline - a RELATIVE degradation against the area's OWN history, never an absolute threshold. A crossing is ADVISORY while the area is still calibrating (fewer than calibration_min samples); BASELINE_WINDOW/DEGRADATION_FACTOR/CALIBRATION_MIN are the recommended D2 defaults, tunable per repo. NOTHING auto-gates on the number: the derivation is advisory, surfaced via the entropy CLI and the dashboard, and is never invoked by scripts/verify.sh, .warp/shape_gate.py, or validate.py run_all.

scripts/selftest.py WARP-1108 AC2: a rising series crosses (alpha latest 30 vs baseline 10) and is TRUSTED (advisory False at >= calibration_min samples); a flat series (beta) does NOT cross (non-vacuous); a 6-sample rising series is ADVISORY (advisory True, still calibrating); MUTATION teeth flatten the latest sample back to baseline and the crossing disappears (the recorded number, not a flag, drives it); and the gate never invokes the entropy module (.warp/entropy.py absent from verify.sh, shape_gate.py; entropy_report and .warp/entropy.py absent from validate.py, so run_all carries no entropy check).

area_static_shape puts the gate's OWN static shape measures on the same per-area map, REUSED from shape_gate's reference analyzers over the area's current source files (enumerated from the contract's area includes): duplication_findings, complexity_findings, function_length_findings, and boundary_findings (boundary pressure) - no reimplemented duplication or complexity, and the contract's own budgets supply the limits. Adoption safe on two axes: entropy_report over a repository with NO architecture contract returns a standdown report (byte-identically unaffected), and a contract with no recorded events yields empty series and no crossings. Dogfood over the real repo: python3 .warp/entropy.py renders real per-area static measures (e.g. runners duplication, fleet boundary pressure) beside the series.

scripts/selftest.py WARP-1108 AC3 over temporary trees: a contract whose core area includes a source file with an over-long function yields static_shape.function_length >= 1, and a short function yields 0 (non-vacuous, reflecting the source); a contract with no events renders an empty series and no crossings; and a tree with NO architecture.yaml stands the whole derivation down (standdown True, empty areas and crossings) - adoption safe.

IN-SESSION ONLY, nothing detached (NG1, the contract invariant no_detached_processes, feedback_no_rogue_processes). entropy_report is a PURE function that reads recorded files (events.jsonl via metrics.load, spec front matter, source files) and takes the events and the trailing-window policy as INJECTED parameters; it starts no process/thread, installs no timer, and never polls in the background. .warp/entropy.py imports only argparse, importlib.util, json, sys, and pathlib.
